name: Sawada Erika
source:
She is a returnee who spent time in France before entering the school. She is so popular that she has formed a crony group called the Sawada-kai in the girls' dormitory.

With permission from the school, she is also involved in entertainment activities such as modeling for magazines. 

In her personal life, her parents' marriage is on the rocks. When her father moved to Japan to give priority to his work, he separated from her mother, who remains in France.

Although her lifestyle gives the impression of being glamorous, she is inwardly a lonely person who lacks self-confidence, probably due to her poor family relations.

She is a member of the rhythmic gymnastics club.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onihei2/index.html]official site[/url]]
